crossRefs.note: “ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make…
For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness…

translations.web: “ ‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
translations.bsb: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
translations.asv: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
